title: Fixed Central Mast Spiral Slide
description: One newly authored complete static spiral-slide frame. One continuous thick open U-section chute descends through three quarters of a turn around a central mast and then transitions into a low straight runout with its own ground shoe. Four full radial underside carriers connect the chute to the mast. A separate complete high entry platform in the open quadrant has two grounded posts, finite guard posts/rails and a whole inclined two-rail ladder with seven fixed rungs and grounded feet. Every whole numeric model part is new, not a rotated or recoloured version of the old single-direction small slide, a winding stone staircase with treads hidden, or an old industrial screw channel. Three constant opaque untextured PBR roles, metres, native Z up, full horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. One whole prop, zero scenes. Unoccupied fixed illustrative exterior only: no sliding-speed or body-clearance analysis, usable climbing route, official facility dimensions, protection or containment, child suitability, structural strength, anchoring, loading, manufacture or playground safety claim.
